meta.name: options-strategy-advisor
meta.description: Options strategy analysis for Indian F&O markets (NSE). Use when user requests options strategy recommendations, P/L analysis, Greeks calculation, risk management, or F&O strategy planning for Nifty, Bank Nifty, or stock options.

copy.tagline: 分析印度期权策略，计算希腊值和管理风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果交易印度NSE期权，需要策略建议和风险分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Indian options strategies, calculate Greeks, and manage risk
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you trade NSE options and need strategy advice and risk analysis

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能分析印度 NSE 的期权策略，包括策略推荐、盈亏模拟、希腊值计算、保证金估算和风险管理。
howto.when: 当用户询问 Nifty、Bank Nifty 或个股期权的策略建议、盈亏分析、希腊值、风险管理或 F&O 策略规划时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析 Nifty 下周的期权策略，我偏中性。
say.note: Claude 会询问具体参数并给出策略建议。

say.text: 计算 Bank Nifty 24000 CE 的保证金和盈亏。
say.note: Claude 会调用工具获取实时数据并计算。

say.text: 推荐一个低风险的期权组合，用于对冲我的持仓。
say.note: Claude 会基于保护策略给出建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze options strategies for Indian NSE, including strategy recommendations, P/L simulation, Greeks calculation, margin estimation, and risk management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for options strategy recommendations, P/L analysis, Greeks, risk management, or F&O strategy planning for Nifty, Bank Nifty, or stock options.

say_en.text: Analyze Nifty options strategy for next week, I'm neutral.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details and suggest strategies.

say_en.text: Calculate margin and P/L for Bank Nifty 24000 CE.
say_en.note: Claude will fetch live data and compute.

say_en.text: Recommend a low-risk options strategy to hedge my position.
